bullet: Final response after navigating back (`F10.navigate-final-response`), known bug.
script:
AN=$(control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/fork" --expect 201 --field id)
U1=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$AN/events/search" --query kind=$MSG --query source=user --check items len-eq 1 --field items.0.id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$AN/agent_final_response" --check response matches '\S'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$AN/navigate" --json "{\"event_id\": \"$U1\"}" --expect 200 --quiet --check leaf_event_id eq "$U1"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$AN/agent_final_response" --check response eq '' --save F10.navigate-final-response/after-navigate  # bug
